title: Closure order (fishing, shoreline or water intake)
description: An order closing a fishery, a shoreline or beach, or a water intake because of a release: who issues it, the area, the effective time, the reason, the restrictions and what will lift it.

marking.description: Exercise marking line shown above and below the form (defaults to EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE)

examples: Waters of Heron Bay from the Causeway to Bayou Sara Point, including tributaries up to the head of tide
A release of about 4,200 barrels of diesel at Pelican Point Terminal may contaminate seafood. The closure is precautionary until sampling shows the catch is safe.
No commercial or recreational harvest of finfish, shrimp, crab or oysters in the area.
Reopening follows the sampling plan: the closure ends when tissue samples from three consecutive collections are below the state action level, by a new order.
